c07782b78cad557435d9.en: The Earth spins round once every 24 hours.
c07782b78cad557435d9.id: Bumi (Earth) berputar satu kali setiap 24 jam.

d6aedc32669a73f684ae.en: The side facing the Sun has day. The side facing away has night.
d6aedc32669a73f684ae.id: Sisi yang menghadap Matahari (Sun) mengalami siang. Sisi yang membelakangi Matahari mengalami malam.

ccc90ecd0b23cb6e4f9e.en: The Sun seems to move across the sky. Really, the Earth is spinning.
ccc90ecd0b23cb6e4f9e.id: Matahari seolah-olah bergerak melintasi langit. Sebenarnya, Bumilah yang berputar.

7036b3d366f0ac9d5a8d.en: Shadows are long in the morning and evening. They are short at midday.
7036b3d366f0ac9d5a8d.id: Bayangan panjang pada pagi dan sore hari. Bayangan pendek pada tengah hari.

12ec3c6cf162187ee315.en: Some animals are nocturnal. Owls and bats are active at night.
12ec3c6cf162187ee315.id: Ada hewan yang termasuk nokturnal (nocturnal). Burung hantu dan kelelawar aktif pada malam hari.
